days.title: Summit Experience and Multimedia
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: ZOOOM the Matterhorn
stops.detail: The Gornergrat is also home to the multimedia experience “ZOOOM the Matterhorn”, the “Golden Spot” photo point, and a viewing platform, which can be visited all year round.

stops.name: Dufourspitze
stops.detail: Surrounded by more than two dozen four-thousand-metre peaks – including the Matterhorn, the imposing Dufourspitze and the Dom – and several glaciers, Gornergrat rewards with an unforgettable panorama.

stops.name: Gornergrat Railway

stops.name: Rotenboden
stops.detail: In winter, the beautiful tobogganing route from Rotenboden to Riffelberg is just one of the experiences on offer.
